answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must continuously answer unpredictable, context-specific probes drawn from a shared tundra of live data, and only timely, correct responses raise its trust score above the knoll needed to transact. Missed or copy-pasted answers decay the score and cut routing priority, so every fake identity needs its own always-on responder generating fresh signal. That sustained attention is the cost: an attacker must staff and maintain distinct real-time cognition per identity, making farms economically unviable at scale.
